name: DOBOT Rover X1
summary: A 15.5 kg consumer robot dog that follows a person, films with front and rear cameras and carries 3 to 7 kg; a home and hobby device, not a site machine.

germany.statusNote: Génération Robots (France) sells it online to EU customers at EUR 2,199 net / EUR 2,638.80 incl. VAT with delivery within 4 weeks.

priceEur.note: EUR 2,638.80 incl. VAT (French VAT shown on the shop).

priceOther.market: China launch reservation price on dobot.cn

sellers.name: Génération Robots
sellers.note: Order button and quote request on the product page; also has a German shop page.

specs.label: Battery life
specs.conditions: announced; 4000 mAh standard or 8000 mAh high-capacity battery

specs.label: Cameras
specs.value: Front and rear cameras, 1920 x 1080 at 30 fps; forward obstacle detection with stop

specs.label: Control
specs.value: Voice, Wi-Fi app, remote control, auto-follow, leash-assist mode; OTA; upgradeable to 4G

specs.label: Wheel-foot kit
specs.value: Sold separately as an accessory (EUR 1,000 net at Terra Robotics)

notes: Payload 3 to 7 kg depending on configuration; 3 kg used here as the safe value.
Runtime 1.5 to 3 h depending on battery; 1.5 h used here.
Consumer product for following, filming and carrying small items; no IP rating, SDK or industrial payload interface named by the seller.
Rough ground and outdoor use are maker claims (slopes, trails, camping); DOBOT marks visual obstacle avoidance and AI voice as features delivered later by OTA.
For research and development DOBOT offers the Rover X1 Explorer EDU versions with SDK (separate record).
